messages:
deploybot: Release 2026.03.20-rc2 failed final release gate for region ap-southeast-1: SBOM signature missing for image gcr.io/redwood/worker@sha256:6a1f2c. Vulnerability scan: 1 medium (GHSA-zzzz: transitive lib), 4 low. Blocked by policy `sbom_signed_required` :warning:

maria: ack. I'm triaging. @sec_ops can you confirm KMS/key rotation in ap-southeast and whether re-sign will be possible without rebuild?

sec_ops: we did rotate the signing key last night but the new key is in the central KMS project — ap-southeast signing role might be missing. Investigating perms now, ETA ~12m.

raj: curious about the vuln — is it exploitable in runtime? If not, we can consider a staggered rollout to us-west while we fix ap-southeast.

kevin: quick note: the transitive package flagged is `libimgproc 2.1.0` pulled by our image builder tool. I ran an `snyk` quick check; exploit requires unauth remote file write, unlikely at runtime for our service.

olivia: we also have a license flag in the SBOM: transitive `old-license` detected (ambiguous). Legal, any quick take? Is this a hard block?

legal: likely noise — looks like LGPL-2.1-or-later for a dep; not a blocker for distribution but requires attribution. Can add to release notes. Not a compliance stop.

maria: ok, two knobs: 1) wait ~20m for sec_ops to re-enable signing and then resume full rollout, or 2) manual override for a regional staggered canary to us-west only (no ap-southeast) and pin image digest to avoid rebuild drift. Thoughts?

raj: prefer option 2. Keep canary limited to us-west (50 pods), monitor error and perf for 60m. If stable, expand to eu-west, keep ap-southeast blocked until signing fixed.

kevin: to pin and push without rebuild: use the existing digest and update deployment with `image: gcr.io/redwood/worker@sha256:6a1f2c` and `kubectl rollout restart -n production deployment/worker`. I'll prepare the kubectl patch.

maria: I'll request manual override in the release console. Deploybot, can you accept an override for staggered rollout to `us-west-2` only and leave `ap-southeast-1` on previous image? Paste below for audit:```override: release=2026.03.20-rc2 scope=regions(us-west-2) reason="SBOM signature missing in ap-southeast; vuln low/low-risk" approver=maria```

deploybot: Manual override requested by maria. Approval required from `sec_ops` and `release_manager`. Audit event recorded: action_id=OVR-20260320-77.

sec_ops: approving for regional rollout only. I'll keep working on the signing perms; will update thread when fixed. :white_check_mark:

maria: approved and kicking off staggered canary to us-west. kevin, proceed with the pin patch. Raj, please monitor logs and pager for 60m.

raj: monitoring. If any error spikes >3x baseline in 5m, we rollback to prior digest.

kevin: patch applied, rollout started: `kubectl set image deployment/worker worker=gcr.io/redwood/worker@sha256:6a1f2c -n production` — canaries at 10% now. Logs look fine so far.

legal: noted attribution requirement; I'll file a short blurb for release notes pre-final.

sec_ops: update: fixed KMS role binding in ap-southeast, re-signing job queued. If successful, we'll lift block and promote region. I'll post proof once signature appears.

maria: thanks all. Keeping ap-southeast blocked until signature proof is in CI. Finishing notes in release doc.

deploybot: Audit update OVR-20260320-77: override executed, partial rollout to us-west-2 initiated. Thread closed for operational updates."
